review_requirements: Confirm the exact NCT04906057/title/IRB 19-1003/date chain and that the same-day pair finalized nine days after study start remained outcome-uninformed.
Preserve the randomized FE-versus-VE contrast and EDSS stratification; do not replace between-group effects with within-group paired tests.
Reconcile the protocol's 20 randomized target with the operational target of up to 24 recruited; registry actual N=22 is conduct context only.
Complete population, estimand, missing-data, multiplicity, effect-interval, software and safety specifications.
Separate feasibility, motor, non-motor, exercise-process and biomarker endpoint families and define their hierarchy.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
notes: First-pass evidence-backed annotation. The independent two-page reference is prospective in relation to primary completion and adds analysis methods absent from the model-visible protocol, but its paired tests do not by themselves estimate the randomized treatment contrast and its terse plan leaves substantial implementation choices for expert adjudication.
